eyebrow.zh: 本地运行 · 跨章锁定 · 分支重绘

headline.zh:
把故事当树，
不当纸。
headline.en:
Your story is a tree,
not a flat page.

sub.zh: 网文连载写到 200 章，角色眼色和第 12 章矛盾了？BranchTree 把叙事状态落盘成可分叉的故事树——锁定角色事实，分支重绘支线 take，合并保留最佳版本，一致性跨百万字不崩。
sub.en: Writing 200 chapters and your character's eye color drifted from chapter 12? BranchTree persists narrative state as a forkable story tree — lock character facts, branch alternate takes, merge the winner, keep consistency across a million words.

body.zh: 想试另一条支线？fork 一条分支，重写几章，旧版完整保留在树里。不满意一条命令退回——旧章节永远在。
body.en: Want to try a different plotline? Fork a branch, rewrite a few chapters, the old version stays intact in the tree. One command rolls back — old chapters are always there.

title.zh: 角色事实锁定，跨章不矛盾

body.zh: 给角色的眼色、身高、伏笔下一条 lock——regenerate 时 lock 强制不可变。写到第 200 章，系统替你盯着第 12 章的设定不崩。
body.en: Set a lock on a character's eye color, height, or foreshadowing — locks are immutable during regeneration. At chapter 200, the system guards the facts you set at chapter 12.

title.zh: 一致性检查，读者抓不到 bug

body.zh: 写到哪崩到哪——一条命令扫全本，标出角色前后矛盾、伏笔遗忘、设定漂移。读者用「设定崩」弃书之前，你先修。
body.en: Find contradictions before readers do — one command scans the whole book, flagging character inconsistencies, forgotten foreshadowing, and setting drift. Fix it before readers say 'worldbuilding broke.'

body.zh: 单进程 CLI，无微服务、无 server 在跑。接 DeepSeek / 豆包 / Kimi 走 openai-compat 协议，你的稿子不离开本地。
body.en: Single-process CLI, no microservices, no running server. Connects to DeepSeek / Doubao / Kimi via openai-compat — your drafts stay local.

sub.zh: 把故事当树——分支、锁定、合并，跨章一致性由工程文件保证。
sub.en: Treat your story as a tree — branch, lock, merge. Cross-chapter consistency guaranteed by engineering files.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 本地优先
